title: TAHB: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Text-Attributed Hypergraph Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.15055v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hypergraphs effectively model higher-order groupwise relationships beyond pairwise interactions, while pretrained language models (PLMs) and large language models (LLMs) provide rich semantic understanding from textual attributes. However, research on combining language models with hypergraph learning remains limited due to the lack of public text-attributed hypergraph benchmarks. To address this limitation, we present TAHB (Text-Attributed Hypergraph Benchmark), the first public benchmark integrating hypergraph structures and raw textual attributes. TAHB contains 10 real-world datasets from four domains - e-commerce, academia, movies, and politics networks - enabling systematic evaluation of text-aware hypergraph representation learning. Experimental results show that TAHB preserves key structural properties of real-world hypergraphs and consistently reproduces performance tendencies observed in existing benchmarks. translated_title: TAHB：文本属性超图学习的综合基准
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.15055v1 公告类型：新 摘要：超图能有效建模超越成对交互的高阶群体关系，而预训练语言模型（PLMs）和大语言模型（LLMs）则从文本属性中提供丰富的语义理解。然而，由于缺乏公开的文本属性超图基准，将语言模型与超图学习相结合的研究仍然有限。为解决这一局限，我们提出了TAHB（文本属性超图基准），这是首个整合超图结构和原始文本属性的公开基准。TAHB包含来自四个领域（电子商务、学术、电影和政治网络）的10个真实世界数据集，支持对文本感知超图表示学习的系统评估。实验结果表明，TAHB保留了真实世界超图的关键结构特性，并一致再现了现有基准中观察到的性能趋势。此外，实验...
tldr: 本文提出了TAHB，这是首个整合超图结构与原始文本属性的公开基准，包含四个领域的10个真实数据集，填补了文本属性超图学习研究缺乏标准化评估平台的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TAHB, the first public benchmark integrating hypergraph structures with raw textual attributes, comprising 10 real-world datasets across four domains, filling the gap of standardized evaluation for text-attributed hypergraph learning.
